phase_note:
2026-07-25 cross-spec review amendments (user-approved; no re-approval required, scope unchanged). FIX 1 (blocking): src/fitdocs/load/settings.py is owned by training-load (task 3.1), whose reader name matches the shipped plugins/inbox convention; this spec no longer creates it. Task 2.2 was rewritten from 'add the shared [load] reader' to 'extend it with benchmark_staleness_days', pinned to load_load_settings(document, settings_file) -> LoadSettings / LoadSettingsError(SettingsError) / DEFAULT_LOAD_SETTINGS, creating the module only if it has not landed and then only to that signature. Every load_settings_from_document reference and every ownership claim on the module was removed; the design component was renamed LoadSettingsReader -> LoadSettingsExtension. FIX 2 (blocking): ProfileView reverts to a pure store view -- activity_date and staleness_window_days are dropped from the view, from AthleteProfile (with for_activity and load_profile's window parameter), and from tasks 3.1/4.1/5.2; both values now ride training-load Amendment 3's per-pass LoadContext(activity_date, settings). Req 7.3 restated as satisfied through context.settings.benchmark_staleness_days and re-traced to LoadSettingsExtension/task 2.2; benchmark(on=) accepts None so Req 3.7 stays checkable at the store. benchmark_age and the staleness computation are unchanged. FIX 3: the contract.document_date accessor is kept but declared as a wiki-contract cross-spec incursion with a revalidation trigger, and task 5.1 carries the sequencing note against training-load task 2.4 (same module and same test module, must not interleave). FIX 4: removed the stale references to the withdrawn calculator (tests/load/withdrawn/test_calculator.py in the modified-file list and the 'shipped withdrawn calculator' risk note) -- verified absent from the tree; deleted in 6386361. FIX 5: requirements Boundary Context gained an explicit 'Not owned by this spec' block and design Non-Goals/Out of Boundary now name load/settings.py, LoadContext/compute and contract.py + tests/test_contract.py as other specs' property. Counts after the amendment (all unchanged by the amendment): 9 requirements / 71 acceptance criteria, 12 design components (one renamed), 15 leaf tasks in 6 groups. Re-verified mechanically: every criterion ID appears in design.md and in a task _Requirements:_ line, no phantom IDs in either direction, every design component claimed by at least one task _Boundary:_ (BenchmarkVocabulary, BenchmarkStore and LoadEngineWiring are each split across two sequenced tasks, as before), task numbering sequential. Open item for the owners, not resolved here: training-load names the [load] reader's test module tests/load/test_settings.py while load-channels, threshold-load and activity-qa-flags say tests/load/test_load_settings.py; this spec follows the owner's name.

2026-07-25 design re-validation, second cross-spec round (user-approved; no re-approval required, scope unchanged). FIX 3 above is SUPERSEDED. Blocking: training-load's own design re-validation reassigned the contract.document_date incursion to its task 4.1, but only training-load's files recorded it -- this spec's task 5.1 still said 'Add the document-date accessor', so both plans instructed an implementer to add the same function to src/fitdocs/contract.py and the same case to tests/test_contract.py. Verified before amending: document_date resolves nowhere in src/ or tests/; training-load tasks 3.2, 3.3 and 4.1 are all unstarted; load/settings.py DID land from training-load task 3.1, so FIX 1's conditional shape is proven in practice. Applied: (a) task 5.1 retitled 'Add' -> 'Ensure ... is available' and rewritten as a consumer with a conditional-create fallback pinned to document_date(frontmatter: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> date | None, mirroring task 2.2's already-approved pattern; a pure block was rejected because task 4.1 sits behind two unstarted peers and would stall tasks 5.2/5.3/6.1/6.2; (b) task 5.1's sequencing note repointed from the retired training-load task 2.4 hazard (landed as a782034) to the live task 4.1 one; (c) task 5.2's _Depends_ now names training-load task 4.1 (or 5.1's fallback) alongside Amendment 3's LoadContext (its task 3.3); (d) tasks.md header note (3) rewritten; (e) design.md amended in seven places -- Non-Goals, Cross-Spec Amendments item 3 (rewritten with the supersession recorded), the wiki-contract revalidation trigger, the Directory Structure comment, the contract.py Modified Files entry, the modified-tests list, and the DocumentDateAccessor component's coordination block and section heading; (f) wiki-contract/design.md item 4 corrected -- it still named athlete-benchmarks task 5.1 as the owner of the landing, so the module's own owning spec carried the superseded ruling too. Counts unchanged: 9 requirements / 71 acceptance criteria, 12 design components, 15 leaf tasks in 6 groups; DocumentDateAccessor stays claimed by task 5.1's _Boundary:_ and Reqs 3.6/3.7 stay traced through tasks 3.1, 5.1 and 5.2. No requirement, component or task was added or removed.
